items.title: Buckingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: I would put the best musicians around her, the best engineers, the best studio. I mean if she didn’t write the songs we found the best songs.

ctx.x: We were on a level playing field if you want to call it that way. I mean Dolly is Dolly and she is a fountain of talent, a fountain of ideas. But she works fast and likes to work fast. I like to work fast. I would put the best musicians around her, the best engineers, the best studio. I mean if she didn’t write the songs we found the best songs. And no, we never argued about anything creatively. At all. In fact there’s just a few times with all the artists I’ve produced that, you know, by the time they got to me,…
artists, they were trying to get their foot in the door so they’re not going to argue with you.

items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: A lot of times, like with Dolly or somebody, they’re great writers.

ctx.x: I had demos. I had demo tapes. Now Melissa is a great piano player but usually when I’d meet with an artist I’d have demo tapes of songs. A lot of times, like with Dolly or somebody, they’re great writers. Melissa is a good writer, a great writer. And they would always have input about their songs. And it would be again like yes, no, I hear this I don’t hear that one. And it’s just a process you go through. And it would be very methodical and very thorough so that when you got to the studio there was not going to…
Did the things that got culled out ever make it to the next record.
